title: Corso: government panic over UFOs at New Mexico V-2 and nuclear sites

tellings.quote: And if you read Philip Corso's The Day After Roswell, the US government went into panic mode because they started seeing a lot of them down in New Mexico where they were testing the V-2 rockets,

plain: John Brandenburg, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, points to The Day After Roswell, a book by Philip Corso named after Roswell, the New Mexico town where something is said to have crashed in 1947. Brandenburg says that according to Corso, the US government went into panic mode around 1947 because many unidentified objects were being seen in New Mexico, where it was testing V-2 rockets, the German-designed rockets the US took over after the war, and also near nuclear sites. If true, it would mean the government saw these objects as taking an interest in its most secret weapons work.
